patches.reason: Check Win32 commit/protection failures, ignore zero-size pre-commit protection, flush instruction cache on RX; protection failure terminates with diagnostic and 0xAEE00001 instead of returning through potentially non-executable dispatcher memory.
Per-instance noexcept observers for actual block lookup and compilation evidence.

Invoke block observers on real cache hit/miss and after Emit seals generated code RX; measure compilation with steady_clock. Reject non-canonical raw program counters before descriptor masking can alias a valid cached code address.
Initialize Windows exception metadata before PreludeComplete makes its code allocation RX.
Use Windows atomic intrinsics for host spinlock operations; eliminate global Xbyak RWX allocation before main. Retain inline JIT spinlock emitters and non-Windows original path.
Bound straight-line translation blocks to 256 guest instructions and dispatch to the continuation, limiting IR growth and budget overshoot.
